additional_info.subject: RE: ID0371361-DC/Si-D/FR-[72So0g]- Charger Offline on SCB/ OCPP CRM:00645000707
additional_info.body:
Hello,
I went on site this week and the 2 DC Outelts were unavailable. I think it was because the SIM Card in the Siemens router was not detected by the charger. Indeed, I was able to connect to the teltonika router and it was written that the SIM is not connected :
So, I removed the SIM Card to clean it and I put it back. Then I did a reboot and the charger went available on the 2 DC Outlet. I see that the charger is available now on SCB and OCPP so it’s okay but if the problem come back, I think we will have to change the SIM Card on the SIEMENS router.
You can close the ticket for now and I will create another one if the problem is back.
Thank you,
Best Regards,
Yacine Kedia
